title: Signed finite-memory deterministic BSGS: exact two-sided coverage

claims.statement: For uniform full-production supplied nonidentity P and independently uniform z, the deterministic signed finite-memory attack in proof.md returns canonical G2 Q with e(P,Q)=z with probability at least 39/100, using fewer than 2^229 total target-group-operation equivalents at protected C=20000. The complete worst-case cold bound includes every failure, preprocessing, sorting, signed-key formation, lookup, transfers, output and verification. Preprocessing below 2^68 equivalents is included. Peak storage is at most 640*2^25+2^20 bytes, below 2^35, including all state; nonuniform advice is zero. No hash, walk, or entropy heuristic is used. This is an analytic finite-memory accounting control, not a practical break or best-known total computation claim.
